extDescription.message: Hold Alt and hover any element to snap and copy its CSS, Tailwind classes, and more.

onboardToast.message: CSSnap: hold Alt and move your mouse to inspect elements. Alt+Click opens the CSS panel.

navHint.message: Hold Alt and press arrow keys to move to parent/child/sibling elements (within the same frame). Esc closes the panel.

copySubtreeTitle.message: Copy CSS of this element and all descendants (up to $1$ elements)

paneSelectElement.message: Select an element in the Elements panel to see its CSS.
